s-1.ptxt: Install Parking Brake Control Pedal Assembly

s2.ptxt: Install the parking brake control pedal assembly with the 2 bolts and nut.
Connect the parking brake switch assembly connector.
Attach the wire harness clamp.
Attach parking brake cable assembly No.1 to the clamp.

atten3.ptxt: Make sure that parking brake cable assembly No.1 is securely installed past the protrusion of the clamp.

s2.ptxt: FF Drive:

s3.ptxt: Securely place parking brake cable assembly No.1 on the guide bracket.

s2.ptxt: Install the 2 bolts.
Attach parking brake cable assembly No.1 to the clamp.
Temporarily install the lock nut.

atten4.ptxt: Fully tighten the lock nut after adjusting the parking brake pedal travel.

s2.ptxt: Install the cable support sub-assembly with the 2 bolts.

atten3.ptxt: Do not pinch the wire harness.

s2.ptxt: Attach the wire harness clamp to the cable support sub-assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Connect parking brake cable assembly No.1 to parking brake pull rod sub-assembly No.1 as shown in the illustration.
Release the parking brake.
Remove the instrument panel airbag assembly LWR No.1 (see ).
Remove the lock nut and loosen wire adjusting nut No.1.
Turn wire adjusting nut No.1 to adjust the parking brake pedal travel to the standard value.
Using a wrench, hold wire adjusting nut No.1 and tighten the lock nut.
After operating the parking brake pedal 3 to 4 times, check that the pedal travel is within the standard range.
Check that the parking brake does not drag.
When the parking brake pedal is released, check that the clearance between the operating lever and the stopper of the rear disc brake cylinder is within the standard range.
Install the instrument panel airbag assembly LWR No.1 (see ).
Check that the brake warning light illuminates when the parking brake pedal is operated.

specitem.ptxt: The brake warning light must illuminate reliably at the 1 notch from the start of depression.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Finish Panel Lower NO.2

s2.ptxt: Push in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to engage the 2 clips and guide.
Install instrument panel finish panel lower No.2 with the 2 screws <C>.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Finish Panel Lower NO.1

s2.ptxt: Push in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to engage the 2 clips and guide.
Engage the 4 claws and 2 guides.
Install instrument panel finish panel lower No.1 with the 2 screws <C>.
Engage the 4 claws and install the instrument panel under tray.

s-1.ptxt: Install Console Box Insert Front NO.2

s2.ptxt: Insert the guide.
Engage the 3 claws and install console box insert FR No.2.
Insert the guide.
Engage the 3 claws and install the console box insert.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Cluster Finish Panel Assembly Center NO.1

s2.ptxt: Engage the 6 clips and 4 claws.
Install instrument cluster finish panel assembly center No.1 with the 2 screws <C>.
Connect the connector.
Engage the 9 claws and install the position indicator housing assembly.
Turn the shift lever knob in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to install it.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Finish Panel End RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 clips and install the instrument panel finish panel end RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Finish Panel End LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 clips and install the instrument panel finish panel end LH.
